detailed_description: The Sitemap Generator creates a simple XML sitemap from the URLs you enter in the browser. Start with a base URL, edit the starter rows or add your own paths, set each page's last modified date, change frequency, and priority, then generate well-formed sitemap XML that can be copied or downloaded as sitemap.xml. It is useful when you need a small hand-maintained sitemap, a quick XML sample for a project, or a clean starting point before adding URLs to a CMS or build pipeline. The tool does not crawl a live website, fetch pages automatically, validate ownership, or split large sitemap indexes; it only formats the URL list you provide.
usage_steps: Enter the base URL, including the protocol, such as https://example.com.
Edit the starter paths or add more URL rows for the pages you want in the sitemap.
Choose a last modified date, change frequency, and priority for each row.
Click Generate Sitemap to build the XML output.
Review the XML, then copy it or download sitemap.xml.
usage_examples: Create a compact sitemap for a five-page brochure site before uploading it to the site root.
Draft sitemap XML for a staging project where the final build process is not ready yet.
Prepare a manual list of priority landing pages for a client review or SEO handoff.
